note: Export templates. Flat placeholders only, resolved client-side: {{value.<id>}} from the form, {{choice.<component>}} from the component selection, {{version.<key>}} from the version matrix resolved by scripts/build_site.py. Multi-line blocks (host lists, runbook sections) are generated by the site renderer, not by a template. Derived placeholders such as {{controlPlaneNodes}} are pre-rendered by the renderer.

exports.description: group_vars/all/offline.yml pointing at the internal registry and file mirror.
exports.template:
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
# Kubespray release: {{choice.kubespray}}

kube_image_repo: "{{value.registryHost}}"
gcr_image_repo: "{{value.registryHost}}"
docker_image_repo: "{{value.registryHost}}"
quay_image_repo: "{{value.registryHost}}"
github_image_repo: "{{value.registryHost}}"

github_url: "{{value.filesRepo}}/github.com"
dl_k8s_io_url: "{{value.filesRepo}}/dl.k8s.io"
storage_googleapis_url: "{{value.filesRepo}}/storage.googleapis.com"
get_helm_url: "{{value.filesRepo}}/get.helm.sh"

containerd_registries_mirrors:
  - prefix: "{{value.registryAddr}}"
    mirrors:
      - host: "https://{{value.registryAddr}}"
        capabilities: ["pull", "resolve"]
        skip_verify: false
        header:
          Authorization: "Basic {{registryAuth}}"

exports.name: MetalLB IPAddressPool and L2Advertisement
exports.description: The address pool for LoadBalancer Services.
exports.template:
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
apiVersion: metallb.io/v1beta1
kind: IPAddressPool
metadata:
  name: default-pool
  namespace: metallb-system
spec:
  addresses:
    - {{value.loadBalancerPool}}
---
apiVersion: metallb.io/v1beta1
kind: L2Advertisement
metadata:
  name: default-l2
  namespace: metallb-system
spec:
  ipAddressPools:
    - default-pool

exports.name: Keepalived configuration for the edge
exports.description: VRRP instance for the edge VIP. Unicast peers, because the DMZ VLAN is assumed to filter multicast.

exports.name: Docker Compose stack for the edge
exports.description: The edge dataplane and VRRP, on the host network.
exports.template:
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
# Dataplane: {{choice.edge}}
name: edge

services:
  haproxy:
    image: {{value.registryHost}}/edge/haproxy:{{version.haproxy}}
    container_name: edge-haproxy
    network_mode: host
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./haproxy.cfg:/usr/local/etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg:ro
      - ./certs:/etc/haproxy/certs:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "haproxy", "-c", "-f", "/usr/local/etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
    sysctls:
      net.ipv4.ip_nonlocal_bind: "1"

  nginx:
    image: {{value.registryHost}}/edge/nginx:{{version.nginx}}
    container_name: edge-nginx
    network_mode: host
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro
      - ./certs:/etc/nginx/certs:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "nginx", "-t"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
    sysctls:
      net.ipv4.ip_nonlocal_bind: "1"

  keepalived:
    image: {{value.registryHost}}/edge/keepalived:{{version.keepalived}}
    container_name: edge-keepalived
    network_mode: host
    restart: unless-stopped
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
      - NET_BROADCAST
      - NET_RAW
      - SYS_MODULE
    volumes:
      - ./keepalived.conf:/etc/keepalived/keepalived.conf:ro
      - ./keepalived.d:/etc/keepalived/keepalived.d:ro
    pid: host
    sysctls:
      net.ipv4.ip_nonlocal_bind: "1"

exports.name: GPU node labels and taints
exports.description: Labels and taints for the GPU worker pool.
exports.template:
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
# GPU Operator: {{version.gpu-operator}}
apiVersion: v1
kind: Node
metadata:
  name: {{firstGpuNode}}
  labels:
    node-role.kubernetes.io/gpu: "true"
    accelerator: nvidia
    nvidia.com/gpu.present: "true"
spec:
  taints:
    - key: nvidia.com/gpu
      value: "true"
      effect: NoSchedule

exports.name: vLLM inference deployment
exports.description: OpenAI-compatible inference server with the model cache on local NVMe.
exports.template:
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: vllm
  namespace: ai
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: vllm}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: vllm}
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        node-role.kubernetes.io/gpu: "true"
      tolerations:
        - key: nvidia.com/gpu
          operator: Equal
          value: "true"
          effect: NoSchedule
      containers:
        - name: vllm
          image: {{value.registryHost}}/platform/vllm:{{version.vllm}}
          args:
            - "--model=/models/model"
            - "--served-model-name=llama"
            - "--port=8000"
            - "--tensor-parallel-size=1"
            - "--gpu-memory-utilization=0.90"
            - "--max-model-len=8192"
            - "--trust-remote-code=false"
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8000
          resources:
            limits:
              nvidia.com/gpu: 1
          volumeMounts:
            - {name: model-cache, mountPath: /models}
      volumes:
        - name: model-cache
          hostPath: {path: /mnt/models, type: DirectoryOrCreate}
